top_signals.summary: Oil prices edge higher as Hormuz diplomacy, soaring freight costs and diesel market fears drive a widening Brent-WTI spread. Interestingly, the US benchmark WTI is set for a steep 7% decline as soaring freight prices and Trump’s toying with the idea of an export diesel ban soured the outlook for the American crude market.
